name: Astec Lifesciences Ltd
about: The Company is into manufacturing of agrochemical active ingredients (technical), bulk and formulations, intermediate products and it sells its products in India as well as exports them to approximately 24 countries. Astec also has undertaken a number of custom synthesis projects, for its clients in Europe, Japan and the US. It is present only in business to business sale (B2B).[1] [2] [3]
keyPoints: Product Portfolio:[1] The company offers a range of products and intermediates such as Tebuconazole, Propiconazole, Hexaconazole, Difenoconazole, Metconazole, Cyproconazole, Prothioconazole, Metalaxyl/Metalaxyl-M and Flutriafol; Quizalofop, Imazethapyr and sulfonylurea herbicides; plant-growth regulator Paclobutrazol; household insecticide Transfluthrin; and intermediates. These control fungal disease, weeds and insects. CDMO covers process development, analytical and safety studies, pilot scale -up, qualification samples, plant design and commercial manufacture of starting materials, active ingredients and advanced intermediates for crop science, life science and consumer-product customers.[2]
